summary: The app is demo-functional but not launch-ready until auth, secrets, and observability gaps are resolved.

findings.title: Admin action lacks server-side authorization
findings.plain_risk: A user may be able to perform actions they should not be allowed to perform.
findings.next_step: Add server-side permission check and tests.

findings.title: Environment secrets are not clearly separated
findings.plain_risk: Production credentials could be confused with local or test settings.
findings.next_step: Document env requirements and add safe examples.

findings.title: No rollback path documented
findings.plain_risk: A bad deploy may be harder to recover from quickly.

next_approval: Approve Wave 1 fix card for P0-001 after reviewing files touched, verification, and rollback.

learning_priorities.why: The app relied too much on UI/client assumptions.
The app needs a documented rollback path before launch.
